sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is absent and mixed historically; no news confirmation available.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (396.64), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent earnings binary event create a highly adverse macro backdrop for Health Care sector positioning.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + RSI14 bullish + supertrend bullish + extreme fear contrarian signal (10/100) suggest short-term momentum reversal opportunity near support (115.62).
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary in 7 days, VIX crisis regime (396.64), price below all major moving averages (50/200 SMA/EMA), stochRSI overbought, zero fundamental conviction, and unfavourable macro (rising DXY, flat yield curve) create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.
